crossRefs.note: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.
Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them…
For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.
When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
“I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. Yahweh…
I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have…
What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has behaved lewdly with many, and the holy flesh has passed from you?…

translations.web: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
translations.bsb: When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
translations.asv: And Jehovah saw it, and abhorred them, Because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
